svg.title: 64 KiB tenant-echo diagnostics
svg.desc: Separate instrumented runs: 4096 timed plus 64 warmup RTTs. Counts include setup and teardown. The near-zero retry count is one, not zero. Elapsed intervals can include preemption, overlap, and must not be added as a CPU or round-trip-time partition. Lookup covers 16646 calls.
